name: Dictator
description:
Offline voice dictation. Press Ctrl+Alt+Space, speak, press Enter: the text is typed where your cursor was.

Speech recognition runs on your computer (Small: tinyasr, 9 languages, the default; or Large: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3, 25 European languages) in a sandbox without network access. Audio never leaves the machine.

Needs the Dictator helper program and a speech model, installed separately: see the project page. The speech model is then downloaded from the settings window.

Clipboard: used only when you copy a recent text from the top-bar menu, or, if you turn it on in the settings (off by default), to paste into apps that cannot take typed text.

Not affiliated with NVIDIA.
